title: FTI-SCHWERPUNKT "ENERGIEWENDE"
description: The FTI-Schwerpunkt "Energiewende" is a national Austrian research, technology, and innovation (FTI) priority program dedicated to accelerating the energy transition, developing PV technologies and components, and supporting climate neutrality by 2040.
